rationale: Test daily range contraction followed by a next-day bullish closing breakout. NR7 absolute-range definition follows StockCharts own documentation. Daily close confirmation, previous-day low exit and10actualday limit are our one prespecified causal adaptation, not the original intraday ORB or an empirically proven edge. Distinct from prior Bollinger/Keltner squeeze families: single-bar rank contraction versus six prior ranges, not multi-day volatility bands.

rules.exit: After closed dayD: Close(D)<Low(D-1), strict inequality; also10actual elapsed holdingdays from executed entry. Exit before entry; no same-hour reopen.
